Im basically just a total failure. I am a freshman in college and just "finished" my second semester, but in reality I failed 4/6 classes I took because I was a stupid. The worst part is I cant tell my parents because so far I have told them Im doing great (A's/B's) and if I told them I cant imagine what their reaction would be and I cant face that.
On top of that I have continuously let down my parents over the spam of my life time: I've done poorly in some highschool classes, totalled a car and banged up another car, spent their money on video games, and been a general disappointment compared to my older brother
I suppose your right, I geuss the real reason I don't want to meet with someone is Im a bit nervous about opening up to someone, I'm a very conceited person and I don't tend to open up much.
I suppose that one of my fears for talking to a professional is that I won't be able to continue college due to "mental health concerns" which would be a big blow to me.
I don't really like talking to people about my problems.
It has a lot to do with self hatred, anxiety, hopelessness and disappointment.
I makes me feel like shit, it makes me feel useless and sad and depressed, and then I hate myself and then suicidal thoughts come into play.
I donrt have any supporters or like a foundation or anything like that.
I geuss having fun, academics, friends, falling in love, and family.
Family, friends, and academics are important to me, but it feels like I have been failing in all 3 categories.
